title: FBI National Crime Information Center apparently breached, CNN and NBC report
date_note: Date of the CNN report as relayed by Arab News (published 21 November, says CNN reported on Friday); the date of the intrusion is not stated.
place: Washington, DC, United States (FBI headquarters; location of the system not stated)
summary: CNN, as relayed by Arab News, said on Friday the FBI National Crime Information Center was subject to an apparent breach, the second in recent months. NBC News, citing two people briefed, also reported it; the FBI had no comment as of Friday night. EFE (via ABC Color) and Infobae report Trump told Fox News it was "no es bueno"; EFE describes this as Trump confirming the attack.
plain: Two news outlets report an apparent breach of the FBI National Crime Information Center, a national criminal database. What was accessed has not been reported.
exec: An apparent breach of a core US law-enforcement database is reported by two outlets; details and FBI confirmation are not yet public.

sources.name: NBC News (Ryan J. Reilly, Colleen Long, Kyla Guilfoil)

validation.note: CNN (relayed by Arab News and CNN Brasil) and NBC News each cite their own two anonymous sources for an apparent breach; NBC says CNN reported it earlier but its sourcing is its own. NBC says the FBI had no comment as of Friday night. No FBI statement read; CNN original answered 451. EFE (ABC Color, 21 Nov) says Trump confirmed the attack in Fox News remarks on Saturday; no FBI or DOJ statement quoted, so status stays developing.

review.note: Compared title, date, 'second breach', two people briefed, FBI no comment as of Friday night (NBC, Arab News, CNN Brasil), Trump Fox News quote (Infobae, EFE) with sources; developing status fits
